1.sahih_international: By the sky containing great stars
1.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
1.yusuf_ali: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
1.shakir: I swear by the mansions of the stars,
1.mohsin_khan: By the heaven, holding the big stars.

2.mohsin_khan: And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);

3.sahih_international: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
3.pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
3.yusuf_ali: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
3.shakir: And the bearer of witness and those against whom the witness is borne.
3.muhammad_sarwar: and by the witness (Muhammad) and that which is witnessed (the Day of Judgment),
3.mohsin_khan: And by the witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the witnessed day [i.e. the day of 'Arafat (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];
3.arberry: by the witness and the witnessed,

4.sahih_international: Cursed were the companions of the trench
4.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
4.yusuf_ali: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
4.shakir: Cursed be the makers of the pit,
4.muhammad_sarwar: may the people be condemned those who tortured (the believers) in ditches
4.mohsin_khan: Cursed were the people of the ditch (the story of the Boy and the King).
4.arberry: slain were the Men of the Pit,

5.shakir: Of the fire (kept burning) with fuel,

6.sahih_international: When they were sitting near it
6.yusuf_ali: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
6.muhammad_sarwar: while they themselves sat around it
6.arberry: when they were seated over it

7.sahih_international: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
7.pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
7.yusuf_ali: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
7.shakir: And they were witnesses of what they did with the believers.
7.mohsin_khan: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).
7.arberry: and were themselves witnesses of what they did with the believers.

8.sahih_international: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
8.pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
8.yusuf_ali: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
8.shakir: And they did not take vengeance on them for aught except that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Praised,
8.muhammad_sarwar: The only reason for which they tormented the believers was the latter's belief in God, the Majestic, and Praiseworthy.
8.mohsin_khan: They had nothing against them, except that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!
8.arberry: They took revenge on them only because they believed in the All-mighty, the Al-laudable,

9.sahih_international: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
9.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
9.yusuf_ali: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
9.shakir: Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is a Witness of all things.
9.muhammad_sarwar: and the One to whom belongs the heavens and the earth. God is the Witness of all things.
9.mohsin_khan: Who, to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness over everything.
9.arberry: God to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over everything.

10.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
10.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
10.yusuf_ali: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
10.shakir: Surely (as for) those who persecute the believing men and the believing women, then do not repent, they shall have the chastisement of hell, and they shall have the chastisement of burning.
10.muhammad_sarwar: Those who persecute the believing men and women without repenting will suffer the torment of hell and that of the burning fire.
10.mohsin_khan: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance, (to Allah), will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.
10.arberry: Those who persecute the believers, men and women, and then have not repented, there awaits them the chastisement of Gehenna, and there awaits them the chastisement of the burning.

11.sahih_international: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
11.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
11.yusuf_ali: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
11.shakir: Surely (as for) those who believe and do good, they shall have gardens beneath which rivers flow, that is the great achievement.
11.muhammad_sarwar: As for the righteously striving believers, they will live in Paradise wherein streams flow. This is the greatest triumph.
11.mohsin_khan: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.
11.arberry: Those who believe, and do righteous deeds, for them await gardens underneath which rivers flow; that is the great triumph.

12.sahih_international: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
12.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
12.yusuf_ali: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
12.shakir: Surely the might of your Lord is great.
12.muhammad_sarwar: The vengeance of God is terribly severe.
12.mohsin_khan: Verily, (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) the Grip (Punishment) of your Lord is severe.
12.arberry: Surely thy Lord's assault is terrible.

13.sahih_international: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
13.pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
13.yusuf_ali: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
13.shakir: Surely He it is Who originates and reproduces,
13.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who creates all things and causes them to return.
13.mohsin_khan: Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).
13.arberry: Surely it is He who originates, and brings again,

14.sahih_international: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
14.pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
14.yusuf_ali: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
14.shakir: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
14.muhammad_sarwar: He is the All-forgiving, the Most Loving One,
14.mohsin_khan: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islamic Monotheism),
14.arberry: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-loving,

15.pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
15.yusuf_ali: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
15.shakir: Lord of the Arsh, the Glorious,
15.muhammad_sarwar: the Owner of the Throne, the Glorious One,
15.mohsin_khan: Owner of the throne, the Glorious
15.arberry: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,

16.yusuf_ali: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
16.shakir: The great doer of what He will.
16.muhammad_sarwar: and the Most Effective in His decision.
16.mohsin_khan: He does what He intends (or wills).

17.sahih_international: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
17.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
17.yusuf_ali: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
17.shakir: Has not there come to you the story of the hosts,
17.muhammad_sarwar: Have you not heard about the stories of the armies
17.mohsin_khan: Has the story reached you of the hosts,
17.arberry: Hast thou received the story of the hosts,

18.pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

19.sahih_international: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
19.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
19.yusuf_ali: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
19.shakir: Nay! those who disbelieve are in (the act of) giving the lie to the truth.
19.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, the disbelievers had always rejected (Our revelations).
19.mohsin_khan: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) and his Message of Islamic Monotheism).
19.arberry: Nay, but the unbelievers still cry lies,

20.sahih_international: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
20.pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
20.yusuf_ali: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
20.shakir: And Allah encompasses them on every side.
20.mohsin_khan: And Allah encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).
20.arberry: and God is behind them, encompassing.

21.sahih_international: But this is an honored Qur'an
21.pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
21.yusuf_ali: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
21.shakir: Nay! it is a glorious Quran,
21.muhammad_sarwar: What is revealed to you is certainly a glorious Quran
21.mohsin_khan: Nay! This is a Glorious Quran,
21.arberry: Nay, but it is a glorious Koran,

22.muhammad_sarwar: that exists in a well-guarded tablet.
